Problem.description: Why a call was refused and what is needed. Field names follow RFC 9457 (type, title, status, detail).
Problem.title: Problem

answer.description: The one answer of every tool. Its own fields are closed: a field outside this list is never sent.
answer.title: ContextAnswer

company_not_connected.title: The caller's company has no Mesh Node

invalid_input.title: An input field is missing or wrong

node_unavailable.title: At least one company did not answer

not_allowed.title: This application may not make this call

not_an_envelope.title: The body is not a request envelope

not_found.title: The id is not in the context graph

not_released.title: The owners released nothing for this purpose

pack_refused.title: At least one pack was not loaded

service_unavailable.title: NeuralMesh could not complete the call

tool_mismatch.title: The path and the body name different tools

unauthenticated.title: The service token is missing, invalid or expired

unsupported_version.title: The contract version is not served

Caller.description: Who the call is for: the end user's company and roles in the application, or the group for a service call.
Caller.title: Caller

request.description: The one request envelope. Fields a newer minor version adds are ignored, the tool's input is checked by the tool.
request.title: ContextRequest

rules: data follows the tool's data schema when the status is ok, partial, no_evidence or blocked
a reader ignores fields it does not know and logs an unknown problem code by its title
the six statuses are fixed within a major version

nodes.description: Companies to ask. Empty: NeuralMesh routes the question
nodes.title: Nodes

ask.summary: A written answer from cited documents, checked sentence by sentence, with the evidence records

entity.summary: One entity of the context graph

skill.description: A skill id (skill:quality-management) or the skill's name
skill.title: Skill

find_mentors.summary: Consented experts of a skill, without names

packs.description: Knowledge packs the registry allows this application to send
packs.title: Packs

import.summary: Send packs the registry allows. Each pack is loaded, unchanged or refused with its reason

inspection_history.summary: Past inspections of an asset, newest first

inspection_profile.summary: Conditions, views, grade scale, expected cover and governing standards of an asset

level.description: The level the learner has to reach: L, M or A
level.title: Level

skill.description: A skill id (skill:quality-management) or the skill's name
skill.title: Skill

learning_sources.summary: Study documents other companies allow for learning that reach the level, by reference

live.summary: A fact that is never stored, asked of the owning node now with the user's identity

record_inspection.summary: Record one inspection as an event in the graph. Images stay with the application

related.summary: Neighbours of an entity grouped by link type, one or two hops

company.description: The company id of the title, for example ceat
company.title: Company

role.description: The role's id, for example ceat:role/quality-engineer
role.title: Role

title.description: A role title, used with company when the id is not known
title.title: Title

role_context.summary: Required skills of a role with levels, concepts, document and expert counts, and similar roles elsewhere

similar.summary: Computed SIMILAR_TO neighbours with reason and score

level.description: The level asked for: L, M or A
level.title: Level

skill.description: A skill id (skill:quality-management) or the skill's name
skill.title: Skill

skill_context.summary: A skill with its description, aliases, related skills, roles that require it and released evidence

vocabulary_export.summary: The group vocabulary of skills and concepts with aliases, as one pack
